p.name: Pyromania
p.description:
After casting 4 spells, Annie's next offensive spell will stun the target.

Annie begins the game and respawns with Pyromania available.

q.name: Disintegrate
q.description: Annie hurls a Mana infused fireball, dealing damage and refunding the Mana cost if it destroys the target.

w.name: Incinerate
w.description: Annie casts a blazing cone of fire, dealing damage to all enemies in the area.

e.name: Molten Shield
e.description: Grants Annie or an ally a shield, a burst of Move Speed, and damages enemies who strike her with attacks or spells.

r.name: Summon: Tibbers
r.description: Annie wills her bear Tibbers to life, dealing damage to units in the area. Tibbers can attack and also burns enemies that stand near him.

p.name: Berserker Rage
p.description: Olaf gains Attack Speed and Life Steal based on his missing Health.

q.name: Undertow
q.description: Olaf throws an axe into the ground at a target location, dealing damage to enemies it passes through and reducing their Armor and Move Speed. If Olaf picks up the axe, the ability's cooldown is reset.

w.name: Tough It Out
w.description: Olaf's Attack Speed is increased and he gains a Shield.

e.name: Reckless Swing
e.description: Olaf attacks with such force that it deals true damage to his target and himself, refunding the Health cost if he destroys the target.

r.name: Ragnarok
r.description: Olaf passively gains increased armor and magic resist. He can activate this ability to become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking.

p.name: Colossal Smash
p.description: Every few seconds, Galio's next basic attack deals bonus magic damage in an area.

q.name: Winds of War
q.description: Galio fires two windblasts that converge into a large tornado that deals damage over time.

w.name: Shield of Durand
w.description: Galio charges a defensive stance, moving slowly. Upon releasing the charge, Galio will taunt and damage nearby enemies.

e.name: Justice Punch
e.description: Galio will briefly step back and charge, knocking up the first enemy champion he encounters.

r.name: Hero's Entrance
r.description: Galio designates an ally's position as his landing spot, granting all allies in the area a magic shield. After a delay Galio smashes down location, knocking up nearby enemies.

p.name: Loaded Dice
p.description: Upon killing a unit, Twisted Fate rolls his 'lucky' dice receiving 1 to 6 bonus gold.

q.name: Wild Cards
q.description: Twisted Fate throws three cards, dealing damage to each enemy unit they pass through.

w.name: Pick a Card
w.description: Twisted Fate chooses a magic card from his deck, and uses that for his next attack, causing bonus effects.

e.name: Stacked Deck
e.description: Every 4 attacks, Twisted Fate deals bonus damage. In addition, his Attack Speed is increased.

r.name: Destiny
r.description: Twisted Fate predicts the fortunes of his foes, revealing all enemy champions and enabling the use of Gate, which teleports Twisted Fate to any target location in 1.5 seconds.

p.name: Determination
p.description: Every third attack deals bonus damage and heals Xin Zhao.

q.name: Three Talon Strike
q.description: Xin Zhao's next 3 standard attacks deal increased damage with the third attack knocking an opponent into the air.

w.name: Wind Becomes Lightning
w.description: Xin Zhao slashes in front of himself with his spear, then thrusts it forward, slowing affected enemies and marking them as Challenged.

e.name: Audacious Charge
e.description: Xin Zhao charges to an enemy, gaining increased Attack Speed and dealing damage to all enemies in the area, slowing them briefly. This Ability gains increased range against Challenged targets.

r.name: Crescent Guard
r.description: Xin Zhao passively challenges an enemy he damaged recently. When activated, Xin Zhao deals damage to nearby enemies based on their current Health and knocks non-challenged targets back, becoming impervious to damage dealt by champions outside of the circle created.

p.name: Echoing Flames
p.description: Urgot's basic attacks and Purge periodically trigger blasts of flame from his legs, dealing physical damage.

q.name: Corrosive Charge
q.description: Fires an explosive charge at the target location, dealing physical damage and slowing enemies caught in the explosion.

w.name: Purge
w.description: Urgot slows himself while he unloads his weapon on nearby enemies. Prioritizes enemy champions Urgot has recently struck with other abilities and triggers Echoing Flames.

e.name: Disdain
e.description: Urgot charges in a direction, shielding himself and trampling non-champion enemies. If he catches an enemy champion, he will stop and hurl them out of his way.

r.name: Fear Beyond Death
r.description: Urgot fires a chem-drill that impales the first enemy champion hit. If that champion falls below a health threshold, Urgot judges them weak and can execute them.

p.name: Mirror Image
p.description: When LeBlanc drops below 40% Health, she becomes invisible for 1 second and creates a Mirror Image that deals no damage and lasts for up to 8 seconds.

q.name: Sigil of Malice
q.description: LeBlanc projects a sigil, dealing damage and marking the target for 3.5 seconds. Damaging the marked target with an ability detonates the sigil, dealing additional damage. If either part kills the target, Leblanc refunds the Mana cost and part of this spell's remaining Cooldown.

w.name: Distortion
w.description: LeBlanc dashes to a location, dealing damage to enemies near her destination. For the next 4 seconds, activate Distortion again to return LeBlanc to her starting location.

e.name: Ethereal Chains
e.description: LeBlanc launches a chain that shackles the first enemy hit. If the target remains shackled for 1.5 seconds, LeBlanc roots them and deals additional damage.

r.name: Mimic
r.description: LeBlanc casts a mimicked version of one of her basic spells.

p.name: Crimson Pact
p.description: Every 30 points of bonus Health gives Vladimir 1 Ability Power and every 1 point of Ability Power gives Vladimir 1.6 bonus Health (does not stack with itself).

q.name: Transfusion
q.description: Vladimir steals life from the target enemy. When Vladimir's resource is full, Transfusion will benefit from massively increased damage and healing for a brief time.

w.name: Sanguine Pool
w.description: Vladimir sinks into a pool of blood, becoming untargetable for 2 seconds. Additionally, enemies on the pool are slowed and Vladimir siphons life from them.

e.name: Tides of Blood
e.description: Vladimir pays his own health to charge up a reservoir of blood which, when released, deals damage in the area around him but can be blocked by enemy units.

r.name: Hemoplague
r.description: Vladimir infects an area with a virulent plague. Affected enemies take increased damage for the duration. After a few seconds, Hemoplague deals magic damage to infected enemies and heals Vladimir for each enemy Champion hit.

p.name: A Harmless Scarecrow
p.description: Fiddlesticks' trinket is replaced by scarecrow effigies.

q.name: Terrify
q.description: Fiddlesticks damaging enemies with spells while unseen or targeting an enemy with Terrify's activation strikes a target unit with fear, causing it to flee in terror for a duration.

w.name: Bountiful Harvest
w.description: Fiddlesticks drains health from nearby enemies, dealing bonus execute damage at the end of the duration.

e.name: Reap
e.description: Fiddlesticks slashes an area with its scythe, slowing all enemies hit and silencing enemies hit in the center of the slash.

r.name: Crowstorm
r.description: A murder of crows flock wildly around Fiddlesticks, dealing damage per second to all enemy units in the area.

p.name: Divine Ascent
p.description: Kayle's attacks are empowered by the heavens as she levels up and spends skill points. Her wings are lit aflame as she progressively gains Attack Speed, Move Speed, Attack Range, and waves of fire on her attacks.

q.name: Radiant Blast
q.description: Kayle conjures a portal, summoning a celestial sword that pierces through enemies, slowing, damaging, and reducing the resistances of all hit.

w.name: Celestial Blessing
w.description: Blessed by the divine, Kayle heals and grants Move Speed to herself and the nearest ally.

e.name: Starfire Spellblade
e.description:
Passive: Kayle's celestial sword, Virtue, deals bonus magic damage to enemies she attacks.

Active: Kayle's next attack smites her target with celestial fire, dealing bonus damage proportionate to their missing health.

r.name: Divine Judgment
r.description: Kayle makes an ally invulnerable and calls upon former Aspects of Justice to purify the area around her target with a holy rain of swords.

p.name: Double Strike
p.description: Every few consecutive basic attack, Master Yi strikes twice.

q.name: Alpha Strike
q.description: Master Yi teleports across the battlefield with blinding speed, dealing physical damage to multiple units in his path, while simultaneously becoming untargetable. Alpha Strike can critically strike and deals bonus physical damage to monsters. Basic attacks reduce Alpha Strike's cooldown.

w.name: Meditate
w.description: Master Yi rejuvenates his body by focus of mind, restoring Health and taking reduced damage for a short time. In addition, Master Yi will gain stacks of Double Strike and pause the remaining duration on Wuju Style and Highlander for each second he channels.

e.name: Wuju Style
e.description: Grants bonus true damage on basic attacks.

r.name: Highlander
r.description: Master Yi moves with unparalleled agility, temporarily increasing his Move Speed and Attack Speed as well as making him immune to all slowing effects. While active, Champion kills or assists extend Highlander's duration. Passively reduces cooldown for his other abilities on a kill or assist.

p.name: Triumphant Roar
p.description: Alistar charges his roar by stunning or displacing enemy champions or when nearby enemies die. When fully charged he heals himself all nearby allied champions.

q.name: Pulverize
q.description: Alistar smashes the ground, dealing damage to nearby enemies and tossing them into the air.

w.name: Headbutt
w.description: Alistar rams a target with his head, dealing damage and knocking the target back.

e.name: Trample
e.description: Alistar tramples nearby enemy units, ignoring unit collision and gaining stacks if he damages an enemy champion. At full stacks Alistar's next basic attack against an enemy champion deals additional magic damage and stuns them.

r.name: Unbreakable Will
r.description: Alistar lets out a wild roar, removing all crowd control effects on himself, and reducing incoming physical and magical damage for the duration.

p.name: Arcane Mastery
p.description: Ryze's spells deal extra damage based on his Bonus Mana, and he gains a percentage increase to his maximum Mana based on his Ability Power.

q.name: Overload
q.description:
Passively, Ryze's other basic abilities reset the cooldown of Overload and charge a rune. When Ryze casts Overload with 2 runes charged, he gains a brief burst of Move Speed.

On cast, Ryze throws a charge of pure energy in a line, dealing damage to the first enemy struck. If the target has Flux on it, Overload deals extra damage and bounces to nearby enemies with Flux.

w.name: Rune Prison
w.description: Ryze traps a target in a cage of runes, damaging them and slowing their movement. If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.

e.name: Spell Flux
e.description: Ryze releases an orb of pure magical power that damages an enemy and debuffs all nearby enemies. Ryze's spells have additional effects against the debuffed enemy.

r.name: Realm Warp
r.description:
Passively, Overload deals even more damage against targets with Flux.

On cast, Ryze creates a portal to a nearby location. After a few seconds, allies standing near the portal are teleported to the target location.

p.name: Glory in Death
p.description: After being killed, Sion will temporarily reanimate with rapidly decaying Health. His attacks become very rapid, heal him, and deal bonus damage based on his target's maximum Health.

q.name: Decimating Smash
q.description: Sion charges a powerful swing in an area in front of himself that will deal damage to enemies when released. If he charges for enough time, enemies hit by the swing will also be knocked up and stunned.

w.name: Soul Furnace
w.description: Sion shields himself and can reactivate after 3 seconds to deal Magic Damage to enemies nearby. When Sion kills enemies, he passively gains maximum Health.

e.name: Roar of the Slayer
e.description: Sion fires a short range shockwave that damages and slows and reduces the Armor of the first enemy hit. If the shockwave hits a minion or monster, it will be knocked back, damaging, slowing, and reducing the Armor of all enemies that it passes through.

r.name: Unstoppable Onslaught
r.description: Sion charges in a direction, ramping up speed over time. He can steer his charge slightly with the mouse cursor location. When he collides with an enemy he deals damage and knocks them up based on the distance he has charged.

p.name: Fleet of Foot
p.description: Sivir gains a short burst of Move Speed when she attacks an enemy champion.

q.name: Boomerang Blade
q.description: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing damage each way.

w.name: Ricochet
w.description: Sivir's next few basic attacks gain additional attack speed and bounce to nearby targets, dealing reduced damage while bouncing.

e.name: Spell Shield
e.description: Creates a magical barrier that blocks a single enemy ability cast on Sivir. She receives health and a burst of movement speed if a spell is blocked.

r.name: On The Hunt
r.description: Sivir leads her allies in battle, granting them a surge of Move Speed for a period of time. In addition, Sivir's attacks reduce her spell cooldowns.

p.name: Salvation
p.description: Soraka runs faster towards nearby low health allies.

q.name: Starcall
q.description: A star falls from the sky at the target location dealing magic damage and slowing enemies. If an enemy champion is hit by Starcall, Soraka recovers Health.

w.name: Astral Infusion
w.description: Soraka sacrifices a portion of her own health to heal another friendly champion.

e.name: Equinox
e.description: Creates a zone at a location that silences all enemies inside. When the zone expires, all enemies still inside are rooted.

r.name: Wish
r.description: Soraka fills her allies with hope, instantly restoring health to herself and all allied champions.

p.name: Guerrilla Warfare
p.description: If Teemo stands still and takes no actions for a short duration, he becomes Invisible indefinitely. If he's in brush, Teemo can enter and maintain his Invisibility while moving. After leaving Invisibility, Teemo gains the Element of Surprise, increasing his Attack Speed for a few seconds.

q.name: Blinding Dart
q.description: Obscures an enemy's vision with a powerful venom, dealing damage to the target unit and blinding it for the duration.

w.name: Move Quick
w.description: Teemo scampers around, passively increasing his Move Speed until he is struck by an enemy champion or turret. Teemo can sprint to gain bonus Move Speed that isn't stopped by being struck for a short time.

e.name: Toxic Shot
e.description: Each of Teemo's attacks will poison the target %i:OnHit% On-Hit, dealing damage on impact and each second after for 4 seconds.

r.name: Noxious Trap
r.description: Teemo throws an explosive poisonous trap using one of the mushrooms stored in his pack. If an enemy steps on the trap, it will release a poisonous cloud, slowing enemies and damaging them over time. If Teemo throws a mushroom onto another mushroom it will bounce, gaining additional range.

p.name: Draw a Bead
p.description: Increases Tristana's Attack Range as she levels.

q.name: Rapid Fire
q.description: Tristana fires her weapon rapidly, increasing her Attack Speed for a short time.

w.name: Rocket Jump
w.description: Tristana fires at the ground to propel her to a distant location, dealing damage and slowing surrounding units for a brief period where she lands.

e.name: Explosive Charge
e.description: When Tristana kills a unit, her cannonballs burst into shrapnel, dealing damage to surrounding enemies. Can be activated to place a bomb on a target enemy that explodes after a short duration dealing damage to surrounding units.

r.name: Buster Shot
r.description: Tristana loads a massive cannonball into her weapon and fires it at an enemy unit. This deals Magic Damage and knocks the target back. If the target is carrying the Explosive Charge bomb, the bomb detonation radius is doubled.

p.name: Eternal Hunger
p.description: Warwick's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. If Warwick is below 50% health, he heals the same amount. If Warwick is below 25% health, this healing triples.

q.name: Jaws of the Beast
q.description: Warwick lunges forward and bites his target, dealing damage based on their maximum health and healing for damage dealt.

w.name: Blood Hunt
w.description: Warwick senses enemies below 50% health, gaining Move Speed toward and attack speed against them. When they fall below 25% health, he frenzies and these bonuses triple.

e.name: Primal Howl
e.description: Warwick gains damage reduction for 2.5 seconds. At the end, or if re-activated, he howls, causing nearby enemies to flee for 1 second.

r.name: Infinite Duress
r.description: Warwick leaps in a direction (scaling with his bonus Move Speed), suppressing the first champion he collides with for 1.5 seconds.

p.name: Call of the Freljord
p.description: Nunu increases the attack speed and Move Speed of Willump and a nearby ally, and causes Willump's basic attacks to damage enemies around the target.

q.name: Consume
q.description: Willump takes a bite out of a minion, monster, or enemy champion, dealing damage and healing himself.

w.name: Biggest Snowball Ever!
w.description: Willump creates a snowball that grows in size and speed as he rolls it.  The snowball damages and knocks up enemies.

e.name: Snowball Barrage
e.description: Nunu throws multiple snowballs that damage enemies.  When he's finished, Willump roots any champions or large monsters that were hit by a snowball.

r.name: Absolute Zero
r.description: Nunu & Willump create a powerful blizzard in an area that slows enemies and deals massive damage at the end.

p.name: Love Tap
p.description: Miss Fortune deals bonus physical damage whenever she basic attacks a new target.

q.name: Double Up
q.description: Miss Fortune fires a bullet at an enemy, damaging them and a target behind them. Both strikes can also apply Love Tap.

w.name: Strut
w.description: Miss Fortune passively gains Move Speed when not attacked. This ability can be activated to grant bonus Attack Speed for a short duration. While it's on cooldown, Love Taps reduce the remaining cooldown of Strut.

e.name: Make It Rain
e.description: Miss Fortune reveals an area with a flurry of bullets, dealing waves of damage to opponents and slowing them.

r.name: Bullet Time
r.description: Miss Fortune channels a barrage of bullets into a cone in front of her, dealing large amounts of damage to enemies. Each wave of Bullet Time can critically strike

p.name: Frost Shot
p.description:
Ashe's attacks slow their target, causing her to deal increased damage to these targets.

Ashe's critical strikes deal no bonus damage but apply an empowered slow to the target.

q.name: Ranger's Focus
q.description: Ashe builds up Focus by attacking. At maximum Focus, Ashe can cast Ranger's Focus to consume all stacks of Focus, temporarily increasing her Attack Speed and transforming her basic attack into a powerful flurry attack for the duration.

w.name: Volley
w.description: Ashe fires arrows in a cone for increased damage. Also applies Frost Shot.

e.name: Hawkshot
e.description: Ashe sends her Hawk Spirit on a scouting mission anywhere on the map.

r.name: Enchanted Crystal Arrow
r.description: Ashe fires a missile of ice in a straight line. If the arrow collides with an enemy Champion, it deals damage and stuns the Champion, stunning for longer the farther arrow has traveled. In addition, surrounding enemy units take damage and are slowed.

p.name: Battle Fury
p.description: Tryndamere gains Fury for each attack, critical strike, and killing blow he makes. Fury passively increases his Critical Strike Chance and can be consumed with his Bloodlust spell.

q.name: Bloodlust
q.description: Tryndamere thrives on the thrills of combat, increasing his Attack Damage as he is more and more wounded. He can cast Bloodlust to consume his Fury and heal himself.

w.name: Mocking Shout
w.description: Tryndamere lets out an insulting cry, decreasing surrounding champions' Attack Damage. Enemies with their backs turned to Tryndamere also have their Move Speed reduced.

e.name: Spinning Slash
e.description: Tryndamere slices toward a target unit, dealing damage to enemies in his path.

r.name: Undying Rage
r.description: Tryndamere's lust for battle becomes so strong that he is unable to die, no matter how wounded he becomes.

p.name: Relentless Assault
p.description: Jax's consecutive basic attacks continuously increase his Attack Speed.

q.name: Leap Strike
q.description: Jax leaps toward a unit. If they are an enemy, he strikes them with his weapon.

w.name: Empower
w.description: Jax charges his weapon with energy, causing his next attack to deal additional damage.

e.name: Counter Strike
e.description: Jax's combat prowess allows him to dodge all incoming attacks for a short duration and then quickly counterattack, stunning all surrounding enemies.

r.name: Grandmaster-at-Arms
r.description: Every third consecutive attack deals additional Magic Damage. Additionally, Jax can activate this ability to deal damage around himself and strengthen his resolve, increasing his Armor and Magic Resist for a short duration.

p.name: Soul Siphon
p.description: Morgana drains spirit from her enemies, healing as she deals damage to champions, large minions, and medium and larger jungler monsters.

q.name: Dark Binding
q.description: Morgana binds an enemy in place with dark magic, forcing them to feel the pain they've caused and dealing magic damage.

w.name: Tormented Shadow
w.description: Morgana casts a cursed shadow on an area, damaging enemies who dare stand in her dark circle. They receive magic damage over time, which increases the lower health they are.

e.name: Black Shield
e.description: Morgana anoints an ally with a protective barrier of starfire, which absorbs magical damage and disabling effects until it is broken.

r.name: Soul Shackles
r.description: Morgana unleashes the full force of her Celestial power as she unbinds her wings and hovers above the ground. She lashes chains of dark pain onto nearby enemy champions, gaining Move Speed. The chains slow and deal initial damage and, after a delay, stun those who are unable to break them.

p.name: Time In A Bottle
p.description: Zilean stores time as Experience and can grant it to his allies. When he has enough Experience to finish an ally's level up, he can right-click them to impart it. Zilean receives as much Experience as he gives.

q.name: Time Bomb
q.description: Tosses a bomb to target area that sticks to units that come near it (prioritizes Champions). It detonates after 3 seconds, dealing area of effect damage. If a Time Bomb is detonated early by another Time Bomb, it also stuns enemies.

w.name: Rewind
w.description: Zilean can prepare himself for future confrontations, reducing the cooldowns of his other basic abilities.

e.name: Time Warp
e.description: Zilean bends time around any unit, decreasing an enemy's Move Speed or increasing an ally's Move Speed for a short time.

r.name: Chronoshift
r.description: Zilean places a protective time rune on an allied champion, teleporting the champion back in time if they take lethal damage.

p.name: Noxious Slipstream
p.description: Singed drafts off nearby champions, gaining a burst of Move Speed when passing them.

q.name: Poison Trail
q.description: Leaves a trail of poison behind Singed, dealing damage to enemies caught in the path.

w.name: Mega Adhesive
w.description: Throws a vial of mega adhesive on the ground, slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it.

e.name: Fling
e.description: Damages target enemy unit and flings them into the air behind Singed. If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.

r.name: Insanity Potion
r.description: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him increased combat stats, and making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.

p.name: Demon Shade
p.description: When out of combat, Evelynn enters Demon Shade. Demon Shade heals Evelynn when she is low on health and grants Camouflage after level 6.

q.name: Hate Spike
q.description: Evelynn strikes out with her Lasher, dealing damage to the first unit hit. Then, Evelynn can shoot a line of spikes at nearby foes a few times.

w.name: Allure
w.description: Evelynn curses her target, causing her next attack or spell after a delay to charm her target and reduce their magic resist.

e.name: Whiplash
e.description: Evelynn whips her target with her Lasher, dealing damage. She then gains Move Speed for a short duration.

r.name: Last Caress
r.description: Evelynn briefly goes untargetable and decimates the area in front of her before warping backwards a long distance.

p.name: Deadly Venom
p.description: Twitch's basic attacks infect the target %i:OnHit% On-Hit, dealing true damage each second.

q.name: Ambush
q.description:
Twitch becomes Camouflaged for a short duration and gains Move Speed. When leaving Camouflage, Twitch gains Attack Speed for a short duration.

When an enemy champion with Deadly Venom dies, Ambush's cooldown is reset.

w.name: Venom Cask
w.description: Twitch hurls a cask of venom that explodes in an area, slowing targets and applying deadly venom to the target.

e.name: Contaminate
e.description: Twitch wreaks further havoc on poisoned enemies with a blast of his vile diseases.

r.name: Spray and Pray
r.description: Twitch unleashes the full power of his crossbow, shooting bolts over a great distance that pierce all enemies caught in their path.

p.name: Death Defied
p.description: Upon dying, Karthus enters a spirit form that allows him to continue casting spells.

q.name: Lay Waste
q.description: Karthus unleashes a delayed blast at a location, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Deals increased damage to isolated enemies.

w.name: Wall of Pain
w.description: Karthus creates a passable screen of leeching energy. Any enemy units that walk through the screen have their Move Speed and Magic Resist reduced for a period.

e.name: Defile
e.description: Karthus passively steals energy from his victims, gaining Mana on each kill. Alternatively, Karthus can surround himself in the souls of his prey, dealing damage to nearby enemies, but quickly draining his own Mana.

r.name: Requiem
r.description: After channeling for 3 seconds, Karthus deals damage to all enemy champions.

p.name: Carnivore
p.description: Whenever Cho'Gath kills a unit, he recovers Health and Mana. The values restored increase with Cho'Gath's level.

q.name: Rupture
q.description: Ruptures the ground at target location, popping enemy units into the air, dealing damage and slowing them.

w.name: Feral Scream
w.description: Cho'Gath unleashes a terrible scream at enemies in a cone, dealing magic damage and Silencing enemies for a few seconds.

e.name: Vorpal Spikes
e.description: Cho'Gath's attacks release deadly spikes, dealing damage and slowing all enemy units in front of him.

r.name: Feast
r.description: Devours an enemy unit, dealing a high amount of true damage. If the target is killed, Cho'Gath grows, gaining maximum Health.

p.name: Cursed Touch
p.description: Amumu's basic attacks Curse his enemies, causing them to take bonus true damage from incoming magic damage.

q.name: Bandage Toss
q.description: Amumu tosses a sticky bandage at a target, stunning and damaging the target while he pulls himself to them.

w.name: Despair
w.description: Overcome by anguish, nearby enemies lose a percentage of their maximum Health each second and have their Curses refreshed.

e.name: Tantrum
e.description: Permanently reduces the physical damage Amumu would take. Amumu can unleash his rage, dealing damage to surrounding enemies. Each time Amumu is hit, the cooldown on Tantrum is reduced.

r.name: Curse of the Sad Mummy
r.description: Amumu entangles surrounding enemy units in bandages, applying his Curse, damaging and stunning them.

p.name: Spiked Shell
p.description: Rammus gains bonus Attack Damage scaling with his Armor and Magic Resistance.

q.name: Powerball
q.description: Rammus accelerates in a ball towards his enemies, dealing damage and slowing targets affected by the impact.

w.name: Defensive Ball Curl
w.description: Rammus goes into a defensive formation, vastly increasing his Armor and Magic Resistance, and returning damage to enemies that attack him.

e.name: Frenzying Taunt
e.description: Rammus taunts an enemy champion or monster into a reckless assault against him.

r.name: Soaring Slam
r.description: Rammus hops into the air and slams down at a target area, dealing magic damage and slowing enemies. If cast while Rammus is in Powerball, Rammus knocks up enemies near the center as well.

p.name: Rebirth
p.description: Upon taking fatal damage, Anivia reverts to an egg and is reborn with full health.

q.name: Flash Frost
q.description: Anivia brings her wings together and summons a sphere of ice that flies towards her opponents, chilling and damaging anyone in its path. When the sphere explodes it does moderate damage in a radius, stunning anyone in the area.

w.name: Crystallize
w.description: Anivia condenses the moisture in the air into an impassable wall of ice to block all movement. The wall only lasts a short duration before it melts.

e.name: Frostbite
e.description: With a flap of her wings, Anivia blasts a freezing gust of wind at her target, dealing damage. If the target was recently hit by Flash Frost or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm, the damage they take is doubled.

r.name: Glacial Storm
r.description: Anivia summons a driving rain of ice and hail to damage her enemies and slow their advance.

p.name: Backstab
p.description: Shaco's basic attacks and Two-Shiv Poison deal additional damage when striking from behind.

q.name: Deceive
q.description:
Shaco becomes Invisible and teleports to target location.

His first attack while Invisible is empowered, dealing bonus damage and critically striking if he attacks from behind.

w.name: Jack In The Box
w.description: Shaco creates a hidden animated Jack-in-the-Box. When triggered, it will fear and attack nearby enemies.

e.name: Two-Shiv Poison
e.description: Shaco's Shivs passively poison targets on hit, slowing their Move Speed. He can throw his Shivs to deal damage and poison the target. The thrown Shiv deals bonus damage if the target is below 30% health.

r.name: Hallucinate
r.description: Shaco creates an illusion of himself near him, which can attack nearby enemies (Deals reduced damage to turrets).  Upon death, it explodes, spawning three mini Jack in the Boxes and dealing damage to nearby enemies.

p.name: Goes Where He Pleases
p.description:
Dr. Mundo resists the first Immobilizing effect that hits him, instead losing Health and dropping a chemical cannister nearby. Dr. Mundo can pick it up by walking over it, restoring Health and reducing this Ability's Cooldown.

Dr. Mundo also has significantly increased Health regeneration.

q.name: Infected Bonesaw
q.description: Dr. Mundo throws an infected bonesaw, dealing damage to the first enemy hit based on their current health and slowing them.

w.name: Heart Zapper
w.description: Dr. Mundo electrocutes himself, dealing persistent damage to nearby enemies and storing a portion of damage he takes. At the end of the duration or on Recast, Dr. Mundo deals a burst of damage to nearby enemies. If the burst hit an enemy, he heals a percentage of the stored damage.

e.name: Blunt Force Trauma
e.description:
Passive - Dr. Mundo gains bonus Attack Damage, increasing based on his max Health.

Active - Dr. Mundo slams his “medical” bag into an enemy, dealing additional damage based on his missing Health. If the enemy dies they are swatted away, dealing damage to enemies they pass through.

r.name: Maximum Dosage
r.description: Dr. Mundo pumps himself with chemicals, instantly healing a percent of his missing Health. He then gains Move Speed and regenerates a portion of his maximum Health over a long duration.

p.name: Power Chord
p.description:
Accelerando: Sona gains non-Ultimate ability haste permanently for her basic abilities as she uses her abilities well, up to a cap. Beyond that cap, further successful uses reduce her ultimate's remaining cooldown instead.

Power Chord: Every few spell casts, Sona's next attack will deal bonus magic damage in addition to an additional effect based on what basic Ability Sona last activated.

q.name: Hymn of Valor
q.description: Sona plays the Hymn of Valor, sends out bolts of sound, dealing magic damage to two nearby enemies, prioritizing champions and monsters. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone bonus damage on their next attack against enemies.

w.name: Aria of Perseverance
w.description: Sona plays the Aria of Perseverance, sending out protective melodies, healing Sona and a nearby wounded ally. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allies tagged by the zone a temporary shield.

e.name: Song of Celerity
e.description: Sona plays the Song of Celerity, granting nearby allies bonus Move Speed. Sona gains a temporary aura that grants allied champions tagged by the zone bonus Move Speed.

r.name: Crescendo
r.description: Sona plays her ultimate chord, stunning enemy champions and forcing them to dance and dealing magic damage to them.

p.name: Void Stone
p.description: Kassadin takes reduced magic damage and ignores unit collision.

q.name: Null Sphere
q.description: Kassadin fires an orb of void energy at a target, dealing damage and interrupting channels. The excess energy forms around himself, granting a temporary shield that absorbs magic damage.

w.name: Nether Blade
w.description: Passive: Kassadin's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage. Active: Kassadin's next basic attack deals significant bonus magic damage and restores Mana.

e.name: Force Pulse
e.description: Kassadin draws energy from spells cast in his vicinity. Upon charging up, Kassadin can use Force Pulse to damage and slow enemies in a cone in front of him.

r.name: Riftwalk
r.description: Kassadin teleports to a nearby location dealing damage to nearby enemy units. Multiple Riftwalks in a short period of time cost additional Mana but also deal additional damage.

p.name: Ionian Fervor
p.description: When Irelia strikes enemies with spells she gains stacking bonus Attack Speed. At maximum stacks she also gains bonus damage on hit.

q.name: Bladesurge
q.description: Irelia dashes forward to strike her target, healing herself. If the target is Marked or dies to Bladesurge, its cooldown refreshes.

w.name: Defiant Dance
w.description: Irelia charges a strike that deals more damage as she charges. She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.

e.name: Flawless Duet
e.description: Irelia sends out two blades which converge on each other. Enemies caught in between are damaged, stunned and Marked.

r.name: Vanguard's Edge
r.description: Irelia fires a massive number of blades that explode outward upon hitting an enemy champion. Enemies hit by the blades are damaged and Marked. Afterwards the blades form a wall that will damage and slow enemies that walk through it.

p.name: Tailwind
p.description:
Janna's allies gain Move Speed moving towards her.

Janna deals a portion of bonus Move Speed as bonus magic damage on hit and with Zephyr.

q.name: Howling Gale
q.description: By creating a localized change in pressure and temperature, Janna is able to create a small storm that grows in size with time. She can activate the spell again to release the storm. On release this storm will fly towards the direction it was cast in, dealing damage and knocking away any enemies in its path.

w.name: Zephyr
w.description: Janna summons an air elemental that passively increases her Move Speed and enables her to pass through units. She may also activate this ability to deal damage and slow an enemy's Move Speed.

e.name: Eye Of The Storm
e.description: Janna conjures a defensive gale that shields an ally champion or turret from incoming damage and increases their Attack Damage.

r.name: Monsoon
r.description: Janna surrounds herself in a magical storm, throwing enemies back. After the storm has settled, soothing winds heal nearby allies while the ability is active.

p.name: Trial by Fire
p.description: Every few seconds, Gangplank's melee strike will set his opponent on fire.

q.name: Parrrley
q.description: Shoots target, plundering Gold for each enemy unit killed.

w.name: Remove Scurvy
w.description: Eats citrus to cure crowd control effects and restore Health.

e.name: Powder Keg
e.description: Gangplank uncovers a powder keg at target location. If he attacks it, it explodes, spreading the attack's damage to enemies in the area, slowing them.

r.name: Cannon Barrage
r.description: Gangplank signals his ship to bombard an area, slowing and damaging enemies.

p.name: Hextech Munitions
p.description: A percentage of Corki's basic attack damage is dealt as bonus true damage.

q.name: Phosphorus Bomb
q.description: Corki fires a flash bomb at a target location, dealing magic damage to enemies in the area. This attack additionally reveals units in the area for a duration.

w.name: Valkyrie
w.description: Corki flies a short distance, dropping bombs that create a trail of fire that damages opponents who remain in it.

e.name: Gatling Gun
e.description: Corki's gatling gun rapidly fires in a cone in front of him, dealing damage and reducing enemy Armor and Magic Resist.

r.name: Missile Barrage
r.description: Corki fires a missile toward his target location that explodes on impact, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Corki stores missiles over time, up to a maximum. Every 3rd missile fired will be a Big One, dealing extra damage.

p.name: Gathering Fire
p.description: Karma's damaging abilities will reduce the cooldown of Mantra.

q.name: Inner Flame
q.description:
Karma sends forth a ball of spirit energy that explodes and deals damage upon hitting an enemy unit.

Mantra Bonus: In addition to the explosion, Mantra increases the destructive power of her Inner Flame, creating a cataclysm which deals damage after a short delay.

w.name: Focused Resolve
w.description:
Karma creates a tether between herself and a targeted enemy, dealing damage and revealing them. If the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted and damaged again.

Mantra Bonus: Karma strengthens the link, healing herself and extending the root duration.

e.name: Inspire
e.description:
Karma summons a protective shield that absorbs incoming damage and increases the Move Speed of the protected ally.

Mantra Bonus: Energy radiates out from her target, strengthening the initial shield and applying Inspire to nearby allied champions.

r.name: Mantra
r.description: Karma empowers her next ability to do an additional effect. Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point.

p.name: Bravado
p.description: Spellcasts empower Taric's next 2 basic attacks to deal bonus magic damage, reduce his spell cooldowns, and attack in quick succession.

q.name: Starlight's Touch
q.description: Heals nearby allied champions based on charges stored. Bravado-empowered attacks grant a charge of Starlight's Touch.

w.name: Bastion
w.description:
Passively increase the Armor of Taric and any allied champion with Bastion.

Actively shields an ally and grants them Bastion for as long as they remain near Taric. Taric's spells also cast off the ally with Bastion.

e.name: Dazzle
e.description: Taric readies a beam of starlight that, after a brief delay, deals magic damage and stuns enemies.

r.name: Cosmic Radiance
r.description: Pulses cosmic energy onto nearby allied champions after a delay, making them invulnerable for a short duration.

p.name: Phenomenal Evil Power
p.description: Veigar is the greatest Evil to ever strike at the hearts of Runeterra - and he's only getting bigger! Striking an enemy Champion with a spell or scoring a takedown grants Veigar permanently increased Ability Power.

q.name: Baleful Strike
q.description: Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy that deals magic damage to the first two enemies hit. Units killed by this bolt grant Veigar some ability power permanently.

w.name: Dark Matter
w.description: Veigar calls a great mass of dark matter to fall from the sky to the target location, dealing magic damage when it lands. Stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce Dark Matter's cooldown.

e.name: Event Horizon
e.description: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through.

r.name: Primordial Burst
r.description: Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large amount of magic damage, increasing based on the target's missing health.

p.name: King's Tribute
p.description: When an enemy unit dies near Trundle, he heals for a percent of its maximum Health.

q.name: Chomp
q.description: Trundle bites his opponent, dealing damage, briefly slowing and sapping some of their Attack Damage.

w.name: Frozen Domain
w.description: Trundle turns target location into his domain, gaining Attack Speed, Move Speed, and increased healing from all sources while on it.

e.name: Pillar of Ice
e.description: Trundle creates an ice pillar at target location, becoming impassable terrain and slowing all nearby enemy units.

r.name: Subjugate
r.description: Trundle immediately steals a percent of his target's Health, Armor and Magic Resistance. Over the next 4 seconds the amount of Health, Armor, and Magic Resistance stolen is doubled.

p.name: Ravenous Flock
p.description: Swain's ravens collect Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently increase his maximum health.

q.name: Death's Hand
q.description: Swain unleashes several bolts of eldritch power that pierce through enemies. Enemies hit take more damage for each bolt they are struck by.

w.name: Vision of Empire
w.description: Swain opens a demon eye that deals damage and slows enemies. Champions hit are revealed and also grant Swain a Soul Fragment.

e.name: Nevermove
e.description: Swain launches a wave of demonic power forward. It then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits. Swain can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer. This ability has a shorter cooldown during Demonic Ascension.

r.name: Demonic Ascension
r.description: Swain transforms into a demon and drains health from nearby enemy champions, minions, and neutral monsters. Swain can cast Demonflare to decimate and slow nearby enemies with a nova of soulfire. This form is indefinite as long as Swain drains enemy champions.

p.name: Headshot
p.description: Every few basic attacks, or against a target she has trapped or netted, Caitlyn will fire a headshot dealing bonus damage that scales with her critical strike chance. On trapped or netted targets, Caitlyn's Headshot attack range is doubled.

q.name: Piltover Peacemaker
q.description: Caitlyn revs up her rifle for 1 second to unleash a penetrating shot that deals physical damage (deals less damage to subsequent targets).

w.name: Yordle Snap Trap
w.description: Caitlyn sets a trap that, when sprung, reveals and immobilizes the enemy champion for 1.5 seconds, granting Caitlyn an empowered Headshot.

e.name: 90 Caliber Net
e.description: Caitlyn fires a heavy net to slow her target. The recoil knocks Caitlyn back.

r.name: Ace in the Hole
r.description: Caitlyn takes time to line up the perfect shot, dealing massive damage to a single target at a huge range. Enemy champions can intercept the bullet for their ally.

p.name: Mana Barrier
p.description: Blitzcrank gains a shield based on their mana when dropping to low health.

q.name: Rocket Grab
q.description: Blitzcrank fires their right hand to grab an opponent on its path, dealing damage and dragging it back to them.

w.name: Overdrive
w.description: Blitzcrank super charges themself to get dramatically increased Move and Attack Speed. They are temporarily slowed after the effect ends.

e.name: Power Fist
e.description: Blitzcrank charges up their fist to make the next attack deal double damage and pop their target up in the air.

r.name: Static Field
r.description: Enemies attacked by Blitzcrank are marked and take lightning damage after 1 second. Additionally, Blitzcrank can activate this ability to remove nearby enemies' shields, damage them, and silence them briefly.

p.name: Granite Shield
p.description: Malphite is shielded by a layer of rock which absorbs damage up to 10% of his maximum Health. If Malphite has not been hit for a few seconds, this effect recharges.

q.name: Seismic Shard
q.description: Malphite sends a shard of the earth through the ground at his foe, dealing damage upon impact and stealing Move Speed for 3 seconds.

w.name: Thunderclap
w.description: Malphite attacks with such force that it creates a sonic boom. For the next few seconds, his attacks create aftershocks in front of him.

e.name: Ground Slam
e.description: Malphite slams the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage based on his Armor and reduces the Attack Speed of enemies for a short duration.

r.name: Unstoppable Force
r.description: Malphite launches himself to a location at high speed, damaging enemies and knocking them into the air.

p.name: Voracity
p.description:
Whenever an enemy champion dies that Katarina has damaged recently, her remaining ability cooldowns are dramatically reduced.

If Katarina picks up a Dagger, she uses it to slash through all nearby enemies, dealing magic damage.

q.name: Bouncing Blade
q.description: Katarina throws a Dagger at the target that then bounces to nearby enemies before ricocheting onto the ground.

w.name: Preparation
w.description: Katarina gains a burst of Move Speed, tossing a Dagger into the air directly above herself.

e.name: Shunpo
e.description: Katarina blinks to the target, striking it if its an enemy, or striking the nearest enemy otherwise.

r.name: Death Lotus
r.description: Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, dealing massive magic damage while she channels to the 3 nearest enemy champions.

p.name: Umbra Blades
p.description:
Every few seconds, Nocturne's next attack strikes surrounding enemies for bonus physical damage and heals himself.

Nocturne's basic attacks reduce this cooldown.

q.name: Duskbringer
q.description: Nocturne throws a shadow blade that deals damage, leaves a Dusk Trail, and causes champions to leave a Dusk Trail. While on the trail, Nocturne can move through units and has increased Move Speed and Attack Damage.

w.name: Shroud of Darkness
w.description: Nocturne empowers his blades, passively gaining Attack Speed. Activating Shroud of Darkness allows Nocturne to fade into the shadows, creating a magical barrier which blocks a single enemy ability and doubles his passive Attack Speed if successful.

e.name: Unspeakable Horror
e.description: Nocturne plants a nightmare into his target's mind, dealing damage each second and applying fear to the target if they do not get out of range by the end of the duration.

r.name: Paranoia
r.description: Nocturne reduces the sight radius of all enemy champions and removes their ally vision in the process. He can then launch himself at a nearby enemy champion.

p.name: Sap Magic
p.description: Maokai's basic attack also heals him and deals additional damage on a moderate cooldown. Each time Maokai casts a spell or is struck by an enemy's spell, this cooldown is reduced.

q.name: Bramble Smash
q.description: Maokai knocks back nearby enemies with a shockwave, dealing magic damage and slowing them.

w.name: Twisted Advance
w.description: Maokai contorts into a mass of moving roots, becoming untargetable and dashing to the target. Upon arrival, he roots the target.

e.name: Sapling Toss
e.description: Maokai flings a sapling to the target area to stand guard. More effective in brush.

r.name: Nature's Grasp
r.description: Maokai summons a colossal wall of brambles and thorns that slowly advances forwards, damaging and rooting any enemies in the path.

p.name: Reign of Anger
p.description: Renekton's attacks generate Fury, increased when he is low on life. This Fury can empower his abilities with bonus effects.

q.name: Cull the Meek
q.description: Renekton swings his blade, dealing moderate physical damage to all targets around him, and heals for a small portion of the damage dealt. If he has more than 50 Fury, his damage and heal are increased.

w.name: Ruthless Predator
w.description: Renekton slashes his target twice, dealing moderate physical damage and stuns them for 0.75 seconds. If Renekton has more than 50 Fury, he slashes his target three times, destroying damage shields on the target, dealing high physical damage, and stunning them for 1.5 seconds.

e.name: Slice and Dice
e.description: Renekton dashes, dealing damage to units along the way. Empowered, Renekton deals bonus damage and reduces the Armor of units hit.

r.name: Dominus
r.description: Renekton transforms into the Tyrant form, gaining bonus Health and dealing damage to enemies around him. While in this form, Renekton gains Fury periodically.

p.name: Martial Cadence
p.description: Jarvan's first basic attack on an enemy deals bonus physical damage based on their current Health. This effect cannot occur again on the same enemy for a few seconds.

q.name: Dragon Strike
q.description: Jarvan IV extends his lance, dealing physical damage and lowering the Armor of enemies in its path. Additionally, this will pull Jarvan to his Demacian Standard, knocking up enemies in his path.

w.name: Golden Aegis
w.description: Jarvan IV calls upon the ancient kings of Demacia to shield him from harm and slow surrounding enemies.

e.name: Demacian Standard
e.description: Jarvan IV carries the pride of Demacia, passively granting him bonus Attack Speed. Activating Demacian Standard allows Jarvan IV to place a Demacian flag that deals magic damage on impact and grants Attack Speed to nearby allied champions.

r.name: Cataclysm
r.description: Jarvan IV heroically leaps into battle at a target with such force that he terraforms the surrounding area to create an arena around them. Nearby enemies are damaged at the moment of impact.

p.name: Spider Queen
p.description:
Human Form: When Elise's abilities hit an enemy, she gains a dormant Spiderling.

Spider Form: Basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and restore health to Elise.

q.name: Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite
q.description:
Human Form: Deals damage based upon how high the target's Health is.

Spider Form: Lunges at an enemy and deals damage based upon how low their Health is.

w.name: Volatile Spiderling / Skittering Frenzy
w.description:
Human Form: Releases a venom-gorged Spiderling that explodes when it nears a target.

Spider Form: Elise and her Spiderlings gain Attack Speed.

e.name: Cocoon / Rappel
e.description:
Human Form: Stuns the first enemy unit hit and reveals them if they are not stealthed.

Spider Form: Elise and her Spiderlings ascend into the air and then descend upon target enemy. After descending on an enemy target, Elise's bonus damage and healing from Spider Queen is increased.

r.name: Spider Form
r.description: Transforms into a menacing spider, reducing her attack range in exchange for Move Speed, new abilities, and a Spiderling swarm that will attack her foes.

p.name: Clockwork Windup
p.description: Orianna's Attacks deal additional magic damage. This damage increases the more Orianna Attacks the same target.

q.name: Command: Attack
q.description: Orianna commands her Ball to fire toward a target location, dealing magic damage to targets along the way (deals less damage to subsequent targets). Her Ball remains at the target location after.

w.name: Command: Dissonance
w.description: Orianna commands her Ball to release a pulse of energy, dealing magic damage around it. This leaves a field behind that speeds up allies and slows enemies.

e.name: Command: Protect
e.description: Orianna commands her Ball to attach to an allied champion, Shielding them and dealing magic damage to any enemies it passes through on the way. Additionally, the Ball grants additional Armor and Magic Resist to the champion it is attached to.

r.name: Command: Shockwave
r.description: Orianna commands her Ball to unleash a shockwave, dealing magic damage and launching nearby enemies towards the Ball after a short delay.

p.name: Stone Skin
p.description: Wukong gains stacking armor and max health regeneration while fighting champions and monsters.

q.name: Crushing Blow
q.description: Wukong's next attack gains attack range, deals bonus damage, and reduces the target's armor for a few seconds.

w.name: Warrior Trickster
w.description: Wukong becomes Invisible and dashes in a direction, leaving behind a clone that will attack nearby enemies.

e.name: Nimbus Strike
e.description: Wukong dashes to a targeted enemy and sends out images to attack enemies near his target, dealing damage to each enemy struck.

r.name: Cyclone
r.description:
Wukong's extends his staff and spins it around repeatedly, gaining Move Speed.

Enemies struck take damage and are knocked up.

p.name: Blaze
p.description: Brand's spells light his targets ablaze, dealing damage over 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. If Brand kills an enemy while it is ablaze he regains mana. When Blaze reaches max stacks on a Champion or large monster, it becomes unstable. It detonates in 2 seconds, applying spell effects and dealing massive damage in an area around the victim.

q.name: Sear
q.description: Brand launches a ball of fire forward that deals magic damage. If the target is ablaze, Sear will stun the target.

w.name: Pillar of Flame
w.description: After a short delay, Brand creates a Pillar of Flame at a target area, dealing magic damage to enemy units within the area. Units that are ablaze take an additional 25% damage.

e.name: Conflagration
e.description: Brand conjures a powerful blast at his target that spreads to nearby enemies, dealing magic damage. If the target is ablaze, Conflagration's spread is doubled.

r.name: Pyroclasm
r.description: Brand unleashes a devastating torrent of fire that bounces up to 5 times off of Brand and nearby enemies, dealing magic damage to enemies each time bounce. Bounces prioritize stacking Blaze to max on Champions. If a target is ablaze, Pyroclasm will briefly slow them.

p.name: Flurry
p.description: After Lee Sin uses an ability, his next 2 basic attacks gain Attack Speed and return Energy.

q.name: Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike
q.description:
Sonic Wave: Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound to locate his enemies, dealing physical damage to the first enemy it encounters. If Sonic Wave hits, Lee Sin can cast Resonating Strike for the next 3 seconds.
Resonating Strike: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by Sonic Wave, dealing physical damage based on the target's missing Health.

w.name: Safeguard / Iron Will
w.description:
Safeguard: Lee Sin rushes to target ally, shielding himself from damage. If the ally is a champion, they are also shielded. After using Safeguard, Lee Sin can cast Iron Will.
Iron Will: Lee Sin's intense training allows him to thrive in battle. Lee Sin gains Omnivamp.

e.name: Tempest / Cripple
e.description:
Tempest: Lee Sin smashes the ground, sending out a shockwave that deals magic damage and reveals enemy units hit. If Tempest hits an enemy, Lee Sin can cast cripple.
Cripple: Lee Sin cripples nearby enemies damaged by Tempest, reducing their Move Speed. Move Speed recovers gradually over the duration.

r.name: Dragon's Rage
r.description: Lee Sin performs a powerful roundhouse kick launching his target back, dealing physical damage to the target and any enemies they collide with. Enemies the target collides with are knocked into the air for a short duration. This technique was taught to him by Jesse Perring, although Lee Sin does not kick players off the map.

p.name: Night Hunter
p.description: Vayne ruthlessly hunts evil-doers, gaining Move Speed when moving toward nearby enemy champions.

q.name: Tumble
q.description: Vayne tumbles, maneuvering to carefully place her next shot. Her next attack deals bonus damage.

w.name: Silver Bolts
w.description: Vayne tips her bolts with a rare metal, toxic to evil things. The third consecutive attack or ability against the same target deals a percentage of the target's max health as bonus true damage.

e.name: Condemn
e.description: Vayne draws a heavy crossbow from her back, and fires a huge bolt at her target, knocking them back and dealing damage. If they collide with terrain, they are impaled, dealing bonus damage and stunning them.

r.name: Final Hour
r.description: Readying herself for an epic confrontation, Vayne gains increased Attack Damage, Invisibility during Tumble, reduced Tumble cooldown, and more bonus Move Speed from Night Hunter

p.name: Junkyard Titan
p.description: Every spell Rumble casts gives him Heat. When he reaches 50% Heat he reaches Danger Zone, granting all his basic abilities bonus effects. When he reaches 100% Heat, he starts Overheating, gaining bonus Attack Speed and granting his basic attacks bonus damage, but making him unable to cast spells for a few seconds.

q.name: Flamespitter
q.description: Rumble torches opponents in front of him, dealing magic damage in a cone for 3 seconds. While in Danger Zone this damage is increased.

w.name: Scrap Shield
w.description: Rumble pulls up a shield, protecting him from damage and granting him a quick burst of speed. While in Danger Zone, the shield strength and speed bonus is increased.

e.name: Electro Harpoon
e.description: Rumble launches a harpoon, electrocuting his target with magic damage, slowing their Move Speed, and reducing their Magic Resist. Rumble can carry 2 harpoons at a time. While in Danger Zone the damage and slow percentage is increased.

r.name: The Equalizer
r.description: Rumble fires off a group of rockets, creating a wall of flames that damages and slows enemies.

p.name: Serpentine Grace
p.description: All Move Speed bonuses are more effective on Cassiopeia.

q.name: Noxious Blast
q.description: Cassiopeia blasts an area with Poison after a brief delay, granting her increased Move Speed if she hits an enemy champion.

w.name: Miasma
w.description: Cassiopeia releases several clouds of poison, slowing, grounding, and lightly damaging enemies that pass through them. Grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities.

e.name: Twin Fang
e.description: Cassiopeia lets loose an attack that deals increased damage to Poisoned targets and heals her for a percentage of the damage dealt. If the target dies from this attack, Cassiopeia regains Mana.

r.name: Petrifying Gaze
r.description: Cassiopeia releases a swirl of magical energy from her eyes, stunning any enemies in front of her that are facing her and slowing any others with their back turned.

p.name: Threads of Vibration
p.description: Skarner's Attacks, Shattered Earth, Upheaval, and Impale, apply Quaking. At max stacks of Quaking, enemies take max Health magic damage over its duration.

q.name: Shattered Earth / Upheaval
q.description: Skarner rips a boulder from the earth that empowers his attacks and can be thrown as a powerful projectile.

w.name: Seismic Bastion
w.description: Skarner gains a shield and creates an earthquake whose shockwave damages and slows foes.

e.name: Ixtal's Impact
e.description: Skarner charges forward and passes through terrain. If he collides with a champion or large monster, he'll slam them into the next wall he hits to damage and stun them.

r.name: Impale
r.description: Skarner's tails lash forward to suppress enemy champions. Once suppressed, the victims will be dragged along by Skarner as he moves around.

p.name: Hextech Affinity
p.description: Gain Move Speed while near allied towers and turrets deployed by Heimerdinger.

q.name: H-28 G Evolution Turret
q.description: Heimerdinger lays down a rapid-fire cannon turret equipped with a secondary pass-through beam attack (turrets deal half damage to towers).

w.name: Hextech Micro-Rockets
w.description: Heimerdinger fires long-range rockets that converge on his cursor.

e.name: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade
e.description: Heimerdinger lobs a grenade at a location, dealing damage to enemy units, as well as stunning anyone directly hit and slowing surrounding units.

r.name: UPGRADE!!!
r.description: Heimerdinger invents an upgrade, causing his next spell to have increased effects.

p.name: Soul Eater
p.description: Nasus drains his foe's spiritual energy, giving him bonus Life Steal.

q.name: Siphoning Strike
q.description: Nasus strikes his foe, dealing damage and increasing the power of his future Siphoning Strikes if he slays his target.

w.name: Wither
w.description: Nasus ages an enemy champion, decelerating their Move Speed and Attack Speed over time.

e.name: Spirit Fire
e.description: Nasus unleashes a spirit flame at a location, dealing damage and reducing the Armor of enemies who stand on it.

r.name: Fury of the Sands
r.description: Nasus unleashes a mighty sandstorm that batters nearby enemies. While the storm rages, he gains increased Health, Attack Range, damages nearby enemies, has a reduced cooldown on Siphoning Strike, and gains bonus Armor and Magic Resistance.

p.name: Prowl
p.description:
Moving through brush increases Nidalee's Move Speed by 10% for 2 seconds, increased to 30% toward visible enemy champions within 1400 range.

Hitting champions or monsters with Javelin Toss or Bushwhack triggers a Hunt, granting True Sight of them for 4 seconds. During this time, Nidalee gains 10% Move Speed (increased to 30% toward the Hunted target) and her Takedown and Pounce are enhanced against them.

q.name: Javelin Toss / Takedown
q.description: In human form, Nidalee throws a spiked javelin at her target that gains damage as it flies.  As a cougar, her next attack will attempt to fatally wound her target, dealing more damage the less life they have.

w.name: Bushwhack / Pounce
w.description: In human form, Nidalee lays a trap for unwary opponents that, when sprung, damages and reveals its target. As a cougar, she jumps in a direction, dealing damage in an area where she lands.

e.name: Primal Surge / Swipe
e.description: In human form, Nidalee channels the spirit of the cougar to heal her allies and imbue them with Attack Speed for a short duration. As a cougar, she claws in a direction, dealing damage to enemies in front of her.

r.name: Aspect Of The Cougar
r.description: Nidalee transforms into a cougar, gaining new abilities.

p.name: Bridge Between
p.description: Udyr has four basic Abilities that swap between Stances and can Recast an Ability to renew it with Ultimate benefits. Additionally, after using an Ability, Udyr's next two Attacks gain Attack Speed.

q.name: Wilding Claw
q.description: Udyr gains attack speed and his next two attacks deal bonus physical damage. Recast: Gain even more attack speed, and the next two attacks call lightning to strike the target.

w.name: Iron Mantle
w.description: Udyr gains a shield and his next two attacks heal him. Recast: Gain an even bigger shield and heal based on max health over the next couple seconds.

e.name: Blazing Stampede
e.description: Udyr gains movement speed and his first attack against each target will Stun them. Recast: Gain even more movement speed and immunity to immobilizing effects for a couple seconds.

r.name: Wingborne Storm
r.description: Udyr surrounds himself in a glacial storm, damaging and slowing nearby enemies. Recast: Empower and unleash the storm, causing it to track enemies and deal additional damage.

p.name: Iron Ambassador
p.description: Poppy throws her buckler that bounces off the target. Poppy can pick it up to gain a temporary shield.

q.name: Hammer Shock
q.description: Poppy swings her hammer, dealing damage and creating a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay.

w.name: Steadfast Presence
w.description: Poppy passively gains Armor and Magic Resist. This bonus increases when she is low on Health. Poppy can activate Steadfast Presence to gain Move Speed and stop enemy dashes around her. If a dash is stopped, the enemy is slowed and grounded.

e.name: Heroic Charge
e.description: Poppy dashes to the target and pushes it back. If the target is pushed into a wall, it is stunned.

r.name: Keeper's Verdict
r.description: Poppy channels a hammer strike that knocks enemies very far away.

p.name: Happy Hour
p.description: Gragas periodically heals upon using a skill.

q.name: Barrel Roll
q.description: Gragas rolls his cask to a location, which can be activated to explode or will explode on its own after 4 seconds. The potency of the explosion increases over time. Enemies struck by the blast have their Move Speed slowed.

w.name: Drunken Rage
w.description: Gragas samples his latest brew for 1 second. After finishing, he becomes boisterous and belligerent, dealing magic damage to all nearby enemies on his next basic attack and reducing damage received.

e.name: Body Slam
e.description: Gragas charges to a location and collides with the first enemy unit he comes across, dealing damage to all nearby enemy units and stunning them.

r.name: Explosive Cask
r.description: Gragas hurls his cask to a location, dealing damage and knocking back enemies caught in the blast radius.

p.name: Mortal Will
p.description: Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.

q.name: Comet Spear
q.description: Pantheon either thrusts his spear or throws his spear in the chosen direction.

w.name: Shield Vault
w.description: Pantheon dashes to a target, damaging and stunning them.

e.name: Aegis Assault
e.description: Pantheon sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly with his spear.

r.name: Grand Starfall
r.description: Pantheon composes himself and then leaps into the air, landing at a chosen location as a comet.

p.name: Rising Spell Force
p.description: Ezreal gains increasing Attack Speed each time he successfully hits a spell, stacking up to 5 times.

q.name: Mystic Shot
q.description: Ezreal fires a damaging bolt of energy which reduces all of his cooldowns slightly if it strikes an enemy unit.

w.name: Essence Flux
w.description: Ezreal fires an orb that sticks to the first champion or objective hit. If Ezreal hits an enemy with the orb, it detonates and deals damage.

e.name: Arcane Shift
e.description: Ezreal teleports to a target nearby location and fires a homing bolt which strikes the nearest enemy unit. Prioritizes enemies stuck with Essence Flux.

r.name: Trueshot Barrage
r.description: Ezreal winds up before firing a powerful barrage of energy that deals massive damage to each unit it passes through (damage is reduced for minions and non-epic monsters).

p.name: Darkness Rise
p.description: Mordekaiser gains a powerful damage aura and Move Speed after landing 3 attacks or spells against champions or monsters.

q.name: Obliterate
q.description: Mordekaiser smashes the ground with his mace dealing damage to each enemy struck. Damage is increased when hitting a single enemy.

w.name: Indestructible
w.description: Mordekaiser stores damage he deals and takes to create a shield. He may consume the shield to heal.

e.name: Death's Grasp
e.description: Mordekaiser pulls all enemies in an area.

r.name: Realm of Death
r.description: Mordekaiser drags his victim to a different dimension with him and steals a portion of their stats. If he kills them, he keeps the stats until the victim respawns.

p.name: Shepherd of Souls
p.description: The Cursed Horde: Yorick can summon Mist Walkers to swarm and attack nearby enemies.

q.name: Last Rites
q.description: Yorick deals bonus damage on his next attack and heals himself. If the target is a champion or large monster or if the target dies, a grave will be dug.

w.name: Dark Procession
w.description: Yorick summons a destructible wall at target location that will block enemy movement.

e.name: Mourning Mist
e.description: Yorick throws a globule of Black Mist that reduces armor, damages, slows and marks enemies. Summoned units gain move speed when moving towards marked targets.

r.name: Eulogy of the Isles
r.description: Yorick summons the Maiden of the Mist that causes Yorick's attacks against the Maiden's target to deal bonus damage. The Maiden will also automatically raise Walkers from dead enemies.

p.name: Assassin's Mark
p.description: Dealing spell damage to a champion creates a ring of energy around them. Exiting that ring empowers Akali's next Attack with bonus range and damage.

q.name: Five Point Strike
q.description: Akali throws out five kunai, dealing damage based on her bonus Attack Damage and Ability Power and slowing.

w.name: Twilight Shroud
w.description: Akali drops a cover of smoke and briefly gains Move Speed. While inside the shroud, Akali becomes invisible and unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks. Attacking or using abilities will briefly reveal her.

e.name: Shuriken Flip
e.description: Flip backward and fire a shuriken forward, dealing magic damage. The first enemy or smoke cloud hit is marked. Re-cast to dash to the marked target, dealing additional damage.

r.name: Perfect Execution
r.description: Akali leaps in a direction, damaging enemies she strikes. Re-cast: Akali dashes in a direction, executing all enemies she strikes.

p.name: Mark of the Storm
p.description: Kennen stuns enemies he hits 3 times with his abilities.

q.name: Thundering Shuriken
q.description: Kennen throws a fast moving shuriken towards a location, causing damage and adding a Mark of the Storm to any opponent that it hits.

w.name: Electrical Surge
w.description: Kennen passively deals extra damage and adds a Mark of the Storm to his target every few attacks, and he can activate this ability to damage and add another Mark of the Storm to targets who are already marked.

e.name: Lightning Rush
e.description: Kennen morphs into a lightning form, enabling him to pass through units and apply a Mark of the Storm. Kennen gains Move Speed when entering this form, and attack speed when leaving it.

r.name: Slicing Maelstrom
r.description: Kennen summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemy champions for magical damage.

p.name: Perseverance
p.description: If Garen has not recently been struck by damage or enemy abilities, he regenerates a percentage of his total health each second.

q.name: Decisive Strike
q.description: Garen gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him. His next attack strikes a vital area of his foe, dealing bonus damage and silencing them.

w.name: Courage
w.description: Garen passively increases his Armor and Magic Resist by killing enemies. He may also activate this ability to give him a shield and tenacity for a brief moment followed by a lesser amount of damage reduction for a longer duration.

e.name: Judgment
e.description: Garen rapidly spins his sword around his body, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies.

r.name: Demacian Justice
r.description: Garen calls upon the might of Demacia to attempt to execute an enemy champion.

p.name: Sunlight
p.description: Damaging spells afflict enemies with Sunlight for 1.5 seconds. When allied Champions deal damage to those targets, they consume the Sunlight to deal additional magic damage.

q.name: Shield of Daybreak
q.description: Leona uses her shield to perform her next basic attack, dealing bonus magic damage and stunning the target.

w.name: Eclipse
w.description: Leona raises her shield to gain Damage Reduction, Armor, and Magic Resist. When the duration first ends, if there are nearby enemies, she will deal magic damage to them and prolong the duration of the effect.

e.name: Zenith Blade
e.description: Leona projects a solar image of her sword, dealing magic damage to all enemies in a line. When the image fades, the last enemy champion struck will be briefly immobilized and Leona will dash to them.

r.name: Solar Flare
r.description: Leona calls down a beam of solar energy, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Enemies in the center of the area are stunned, while enemies on the outside are slowed.

p.name: Void Shift
p.description: When he hasn't recently taken damage or been crowd controlled, Malzahar gains massive damage reduction and crowd control immunity, lingering for a short period after taking damage.

q.name: Call of the Void
q.description: Malzahar opens up two portals to the Void. After a short delay, they fire projectiles that deal Magic Damage and silence enemy champions.

w.name: Void Swarm
w.description: Malzahar summons Voidlings to attack nearby enemies.

e.name: Malefic Visions
e.description:
Malzahar infects his target's mind with cruel visions of their demise, dealing damage over time. Using Malzahar's other spells on the target will refresh the visions.

If the target dies while afflicted by the visions, they pass on to a nearby enemy unit and Malzahar gains Mana. Malzahar's Voidlings are attracted to affected units.

r.name: Nether Grasp
r.description: Malzahar channels the essence of the Void to suppress an enemy champion over a zone of damaging negative energy.

p.name: Blade's End
p.description: Talon's spells Wound champions and large monsters, stacking up to 3 times. When Talon attacks a champion with 3 stacks of Wound, they bleed for heavy damage over time.

q.name: Noxian Diplomacy
q.description: Talon stabs the target unit. If they are within melee range, this attack deals critical damage. If they are outside melee range, Talon will leap at his target before stabbing them. Talon refunds some health and cooldown if this ability kills the target.

w.name: Rake
w.description: Talon sends out a volley of daggers that then return back to him, dealing physical damage every time it passes through an enemy. The returning blades deal bonus damage and slow units hit.

e.name: Assassin's Path
e.description: Talon vaults over any terrain or structure, up to a max distance. This ability has a low cooldown, but puts the used terrain on a long cooldown.

r.name: Shadow Assault
r.description: Talon disperses a ring of blades and becomes Invisible while gaining additional Move Speed. When Talon emerges from Invisibility, the blades converge on his location. Each time the blades move, Shadow Assault deals physical damage to enemies hit by at least one blade.

p.name: Runic Blade
p.description: Riven's abilities charge her blade, and her basic attacks expend charges to deal an additional damage.

q.name: Broken Wings
q.description: Riven lashes out in a series of strikes. This ability can be reactivated three times in a short time frame with the third hit knocking back nearby enemies.

w.name: Ki Burst
w.description: Riven emits a Ki Burst, damaging and stunning nearby enemies.

e.name: Valor
e.description: Riven steps forward a short distance and blocks incoming damage.

r.name: Blade of the Exile
r.description: Riven empowers her keepsake weapon with energy, and gains Attack Damage and Range. During this time, she also gains the ability to use Wind Slash, a powerful ranged attack, once.

p.name: Icathian Surprise
p.description: 4 seconds after dying, Kogmaw explodes, dealing true damage to surrounding enemies.

q.name: Caustic Spittle
q.description: Kog'Maw launches a corrosive projectile which deals magic damage and corrodes the target's armor and magic resist for a short time. Kog'Maw also gains additional attack speed.

w.name: Bio-Arcane Barrage
w.description: Kog'Maw's attacks gain range and deal a percent of the target's maximum health as magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit.

e.name: Void Ooze
e.description: Kog'Maw launches a peculiar ooze which damages all enemies it passes through and leaves a trail which slows enemies who stand on it.

r.name: Living Artillery
r.description: Kog'Maw fires an artillery shell at a great distance dealing magic damage (increased significantly on low health enemies) and revealing non-stealthed targets. Additionally, multiple Living Artilleries in a short period of time cause them to cost additional Mana.

p.name: Ki Barrier
p.description: After casting a spell, Shen gets a shield. Affecting other champions reduces the cooldown of this effect.

q.name: Twilight Assault
q.description: Shen recalls his spirit blade to attack with it, dealing damage based on the target's max health. The attacks are greatly empowered if it collides with an enemy champion, and all collided enemies are slowed while running away from Shen.

w.name: Spirit's Refuge
w.description: Attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked.

e.name: Shadow Dash
e.description: Shen dashes in a direction, taunting enemies in his path.

r.name: Stand United
r.description: Shen shields target allied champion from incoming damage, and soon after teleports to their location.

p.name: Illumination
p.description: Lux's damaging spells charge the target with energy for a few seconds. Lux's next attack ignites the energy, dealing bonus magic damage (depending on Lux's level) to the target.

q.name: Light Binding
q.description: Lux releases a sphere of light that binds and deals damage to up to two enemy units.

w.name: Prismatic Barrier
w.description: Lux throws her wand and bends the light around any friendly target it touches, protecting them from enemy damage.

e.name: Lucent Singularity
e.description: Fires an anomaly of twisted light to an area, which slows nearby enemies. Lux can detonate it to damage enemies in the area of effect.

r.name: Final Spark
r.description: After gathering energy, Lux fires a beam of light that deals damage to all targets in the area. In addition, triggers Lux's passive ability and refreshes the Illumination debuff duration.

p.name: Mana Surge
p.description: Xerath's basic attacks periodically restore Mana. Whenever Xerath kills a unit, this cooldown is reduced.

q.name: Arcanopulse
q.description: Fires a long-range beam of energy, dealing magic damage to all targets hit.

w.name: Eye of Destruction
w.description: Calls down a barrage of arcane energy, slowing and dealing magic damage to all enemies in an area. Targets in the middle receive additional damage and a stronger slow.

e.name: Shocking Orb
e.description: Deals magic damage to an enemy and stuns them.

r.name: Rite of the Arcane
r.description: Xerath immobilizes himself and gains numerous long-range barrages.

p.name: Scalemail
p.description: Takedowns on enemy champions, large minions, and large monsters grant Shyvana Scalemail stacks, improving her defenses.

q.name: Emberstrike
q.description: Shyvana's next attack strikes both the target and the surrounding area. This Ability can be recast. While in Dragon Form, it gains an additional recast, dealing massive damage to a single target.

w.name: Inferno Aegis
w.description: Shyvana gains a shield, movement speed, and after a short delay, the area around her detonates.  While in Dragon Form, the explosion will heal her if it strikes an enemy champion.

e.name: Molten Burst
